Chapter 6578: Hot

Chapter 6578: Hot

First Vine was not a normal overlord since he played a major part in Dingtian’s demise. To him, mortals were mere insects.

How could a true dragon fall in love with an insect? Even new cultivators couldn’t do so for a simple reason - the short lifespan of the mortals.

A century was considered long in their timeline. As for cultivators, novices could live several centuries. As they grew stronger, their lifespan could reach the millions.

This was the reason why outsiders didn’t believe in First Vine being the Teng’s progenitor and thought they were exaggerating their prestige. Plus, a tale of love needed to stand out to be remembered.

“It was beautiful indeed.” She said softly, appreciating this stranger for believing them.

When she first came back to this residence, she felt the urge to embrace a mortal life. Of course, she wasn’t on the same level as an overlord.

Li Qiye smiled and headed for the residence. She regained her wits and followed him inside.

“May I ask why you are here, Fellow Daoist?” She found him rude for treating the place like his own home.

She had been the sole occupant until now, when this man intruded.

“I’ll be spending the night here.” He casually said.

“...” This left her speechless.

“This is my place, Fellow Daoist. Please be respectful.” She displayed impressive restraint due to recent experience. Her past self would have taken out her blade for a swing.

After seeing him coming to rest on the bed, she took out her weapon and released an aura strong enough to crush the room.

“Go, don’t bother me.” Li Qiye waved and ordered: “Prepare some tea at noon for me as well.”

Not only was he staying in her room, he also demanded her service. She didn’t know what to say and stood there in confusion.

She was both talented and beautiful, having no lack of suitors. Although she was on a downward trend with her cultivation damaged, these suitors still wanted to please her.

However, she didn’t want to see them given her current mood. Once she calmed down, she saw that he was asleep already.

She would have cut an intruder in her bedroom to pieces in the past but now, she was mesmerized by his peaceful sleeping. There was a devilish charisma to his nonchalant rudeness.

All in all, she had no clue what was going on. She even covered him with a blanket before leaving.

While standing outside the door, she smiled wryly and shook her head at her ridiculous action.

At noon, she prepared a table and tea for him in the courtyard. He woke up and stretched before sitting down, yawning in between.

She poured a cup of tea for him while thinking that she was crazy for acting like a maid. Nevertheless, everything felt so natural. Perhaps she was struck with a spell.

“It’s hot.” Li Qiye took a sip and complained.

“You blow it...” She understood what he wanted and blurted.

However, once she spoke, she thought she had done something wrong and regretted making a complaint. She picked up the cup and blew on the tea before giving it back to him.

“I’m not your maid.” She muttered as he took another sip, feeling increasingly annoyed while glaring at him.

“This is an honor.” He looked at her and said.
